title: Jesus... Why Did I Stay Quiet When She Took My Credit? 😤
topic: his teammate presented the fix he built as her own at the morning standup, and he stayed quiet all day

bible.text: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... my teammate read out my fix in the standup. My name wasn't said. 😤

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I corrected her in my head the whole rest of the day.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Anger at unfairness isn't the enemy. Silence that swallows it is.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: If I speak up, I look petty. If I don't, my work walks away wearing her name.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: A gentle answer can still be a clear one. Clarity costs less than resentment.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Say it once, calmly, in the room where it happened. That's enough.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Have you ever had your credit taken? 👇
